description: This file defines the YamlPecl class which provides YAML serialization and deserialization using the PECL extension within the Drupal framework. It includes methods for encoding, decoding, error handling, and applying boolean callbacks, and is part of the Drupal Component Serialization namespace.

classes.name: YamlPecl
classes.description: Provides YAML serialization and deserialization using the PECL extension, with methods for encoding, decoding, error handling, and boolean value processing.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Serializes data into YAML format with specific indentation and width settings.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Deserializes YAML string into PHP data, with error handling and binary decoding configuration.

methods.name: errorHandler
methods.description: Handles errors during YAML decoding by throwing an InvalidDataTypeException.

methods.name: getFileExtension
methods.description: Returns the file extension 'yml' for YAML files.

methods.name: applyBooleanCallbacks
methods.description: Converts specific string values to boolean according to YAML 1.2 standards, ignoring YAML 1.1 boolean representations.
